variants.name: Current architecture
variants.summary: Module level: semantic-viewer as implemented on 2026-09-13. Follow linked subjects for related levels.

nodes.name: Browser client
nodes.description: The parent browser service mounts this module in each semantic pane.

nodes.name: Semantic viewer
nodes.description: The read-only semantic-board-canvas module. Server bytes define content and geometry; local state defines only how a person reads them.

nodes.name: Fetch semantic reads
nodes.description: Calls the three semantic HTTP read routes and converts refused, unreachable, or invalid replies into explicit viewer failures.

nodes.name: Resolve board meaning
nodes.description: Parses the board document, resolves the shown variant, describes nodes, edges, flows, steps, bindings, containment, and proposal standing.

nodes.name: Render stage states
nodes.description: The renderedView and stageBody functions in SemanticBoardStage.tsx present loading, empty, error, stale, drawn, inspection, variant, view, walkthrough, and drill trail surfaces from the entry point’s query and reading state.

nodes.name: Control camera
nodes.description: Computes clamped camera transforms for the server drawing without persisting or inventing board geometry.

nodes.name: Select semantic subjects
nodes.description: Accepts only semantic IDs present in the server atlas and toggles the shared attention mark on rendered groups.

nodes.name: Follow drill-downs
nodes.description: Resolves exact current or named target variants, owns the local trail, and resets level-specific view and variant readings safely.

nodes.name: Drive walkthrough focus
nodes.description: Maps beat subjects through the atlas to a focus rectangle and reports named subjects missing from the current view.

nodes.name: Refresh changed boards
nodes.description: Hears board version announcements from the pane socket and invalidates matching semantic query keys while retaining usable stale drawings.

nodes.name: Viewer entry point
nodes.description: SemanticBoardStage is the public component mounted by ApplicationPane. It starts the render query through semanticRenderQuery/useQuery, owns the reading hooks, and supplies query state to renderedView.

beats.heading: Obtain authoritative meaning
beats.body: ApplicationPane mounts SemanticBoardStage inside the Semantic viewer boundary. This entry point initiates semantic queries; the API decodes the board and server-rendered picture, and board-document resolution makes inspectable meaning available beside the SVG.

beats.heading: Own only the reading
beats.body: The stage presents explicit states while camera and subject selection change local attention without changing board content or geometry.

beats.heading: Explain across levels
beats.body: Walkthrough beats focus atlas subjects, drill-down resolves the exact linked architecture, and change announcements refresh cached server reads.
